speaker: Matthew Meloy
title: CEO at Targa Resources

Our best-in-class footprint generates significant growth opportunities as we continue to expand our system and bolt-on growth projects. This commercial success further adds to our long-term growth rate and gives us confidence in our capital program. speaker: Matthew Meloy
title: CEO at Targa Resources
msg: Our next Delaware processing plant, Yeti Two, and our thirteenth fractionator in Mont Belvieu. For perspective, this incremental plant infrastructure alone would amount to the 5th largest processor in the basin. speaker: Jen Kneale
title: President at Targa Resources

In 2026, we look forward to placing our next 3 processing plants in service, including Falcon Two in the Permian Delaware and East Pembrook and East Driver in the Permian Midland. We continue to expect our new plants will be much needed at startup. Our Falcon Two plant is expected to come online ahead of schedule and is currently in startup, and our remaining announced plants underway for 2026 and 2027 remain on track.

speaker: Jen Kneale
title: President at Targa Resources

Additionally, we continue to add connectivity and redundancy to our Permian residue capabilities with our announced in-basin natural gas projects, including the Bull Run Extension, Buffalo Run, and Forza, which all remain on track, subject to the receipt of the necessary regulatory approvals. speaker: Jen Kneale
title: President at Targa Resources

speaker: Jen Kneale
title: President at Targa Resources

speaker: Will Byers

speaker: Will Byers
title: CFO at Targa Resources
msg: We expect approximately $4.5 billion of growth capital spending in 2026, supporting our major projects and continued volume growth. speaker: Will Byers
title: CFO at Targa Resources
